summary: Iteration 14 (radius filter + 30-day retention + ACR filter on Terhapus). BACKEND (test_iteration14.py, 9/9 PASS): (1) Radius filter on nearest — no radius returns 45 (both plain and nearest without radius_km), radius_km=5 returns 1 asset with every item having distance_km<=5, radius_km=25 returns 10 items strictly more than 5km (all distance_km<=25). ACR filter click and 'Semua ACR' both keep the card visible (only one ACR present, expected). Prior regression from iter 13 (rcg /sold missing decorator) is FIXED. Test-deleted MA asset was restored at end; catalog is back to 45.
